MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 987
AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 782 FOR THE PURPOSE OF EXTENDING THE PERIOD
FOR CONVERTING VALID AND SUBSISTING PETROLEUM EXPLORATION CONCESSIONS AND
PUBLISHED PETROLEUM EXPLORATION APPLICATIONS FROM AUGUST 25, 1976 TO
In order to give holders of valid and subsisting Petroleum Exploration Concessions (PECs) and published
Petroleum Exploration Concession Applications (PECAs) sufficient time to upgrade their technical and
financial capabilities to develop a viable exploration program under the service contract system and in line
with the declared policy of the state to hasten the discovery, development and production of indigenous
petroleum, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me
by the Constitution, do hereby amend Presidential Decree No. 782, particularly Section 2 thereof, by
extending the deadline for conversion of valid and subsisting concessions and concession applications to
service contracts from August 25, 1976 to December 31, 1976: Provided, That, the extension shall apply only
to those concessions that have complied with their work obligations and the applicable implementing rules
and of the date of this decree: And provided, further, That the holders of said concessions and/or concession
applications are technically and financially qualified under the rules for conversion issued by the Energy
Development Board and do not have any unpaid deficiency obligations arising from any concessions held by
them. No further extension shall be allowed after this and all concessions and concession applications not
converted to service contracts for any cause before December 31, 1976, 1976 shall be deemed automatically
cancelled and the area covered thereby shall become part of the National Reserve Area.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
